column1: # Regenerate:  VAC_UPDATE_BASELINES=1 cargo test --release -p vac --test corpus
# `hash` is FNV-1a over the input file's bytes. The inputs themselves are
# gitignored and re-fetched, so a hash mismatch means the source material
# changed — the row is skipped rather than reported as a regression.
# ink_iou / worst_iou / residual / psnr_db are FIDELITY: how much of the
# picture survived. shapes / animate / keyframes / vac_bytes are STRUCTURE:
# what it cost. Only the first group says whether VAC is getting better.
